newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 42.5000/5300 to the dollar against a previous 42.5200/5300 after banks attempted to offload large volumes of the U.S. currency in the interbank market, dealers said.
"There was a big mismatch between demand and supply (of dollar). Market got flooded with selling offers (of dollar)," said one dealer.
Dealers said increased remittance inflow and a simultaneous slump in import activity over the recent weeks had eased the greenback.
The call money was traded at 6.5 to 7.0 percent, down slightly from Tuesday's 6.5-7.5, dealers said.
